headline: Set the November 17 meeting agenda, including AI training with Leslie Parker and a 405 update.
summary: A motion to approve the agenda and September minutes was made, and no one from the public spoke during public forum. The November 17 agenda lists board business, AI training with Leslie Parker, and a Director's report.
plain_text:
Executive Committee Meeting – Monday November 9, 2026 
1) Approve Agenda & Minutes 
a. Motion to approve the agenda and September meeting minutes made by Lori, 
seconded by Michelle  
2) Public Forum 
a. No one from the public 
 
3) Set Agenda for November 17 Board Meeting 
a. Board Business 3:00-3:30 
b. AI Training with Leslie Parker (incl. Foundation Board) 3:30-5:00 
c. Doreen will send Director’s report in advance, to include updates on Warhol 
grant, gallery programming, calendar of events, French millennial show 
d. Agenda: 
i. 405 Update 
ii. Financial Update 
iii. Time for questions about Director’s Report 
iv. Development Committee Update 
1. Distribute Pledge Forms 
4) Adjournment 
a. Motion by Lori, seconded by Laura
